Name: DEPRECATED - Baechu-styled portraits for Child to NPC for SVE
Author: AkiraE
Description:
[center][size=3][color=#ff7700][size=4]I no longer have the time to maintain this mod, and, even if I had, I lack the interest for doing so, as I no longer play the game or have it installed. 
[/size][/color]
[size=4][b][/b][/size][size=4][b]I'm keeping the mod up per request, but keep in mind that it is highly outdated and I no longer offer any support for it.
[/b][/size][color=#ff7700]And by "highly outdated" I mean that you will very likely see the vanilla portraits in a few cases and so on.[/color][color=#ff7700]


[/color]═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

﻿﻿Hey!

These are a set of portraits for use with the NPC Child for SVE mod, made to match [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5597]these[/url]﻿ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5397]two[/url]﻿ portraits sets. 
Every character has been done, except for girl Krobus (I won't add her).
As Xiddav adds new content for the boys, I will be updating this mod accordingly.

This is planned to be last portrait set from that "series", so I won't be taking requests anymore.[/size]
﻿

═════════════════  *.·:·.☽✧    ✦    ✧☾.·:·.*  ═════════════════


[size=4][b]REQUIREMENTS[/b][/size]
[size=3]
 ✦  [url=https://github.com/loe2run/ChildToNPC]Child to NPC[/url]﻿

✦ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]﻿

✦ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5436]NPC Child for SVE[/url]﻿
[/size]


═════════════════  *.·:·.☽✧    ✦    ✧☾.·:·.*  ═════════════════


[b][size=4]INSTALLATION[/size]

[size=3]You [u]must[/u] have all the mods in the requirements installed [u]beforehand[/u].[/size][/b][size=3]

✦ Merge the "[CP] Xiddavs ChildToNPC Dispositions Gift taste sprites and portraits"
contained inside the folder you get after unzipping with the original one with the same name from Xiddav's mod,
allowing the files be replaced.

[/size][size=3]✦ That's all. 

[b]Note:[/b] [u]Do not [/u]install the entire "[Stardew] Baechu-styled portraits for Xiddavs ChildToNPC" folder.
[u]You'll get a SMAPI error instead and the portraits won't work.[/u]

[/size][size=3]
═════════════════  *.·:·.☽✧    ✦    ✧☾.·:·.*  ═════════════════


[/size][size=4][b]CREDITS[/b][/size] 
[size=3]
[/size][size=3]My retextures consists of frankensteined and edited assets from existing portraits by Baechu﻿, therefore, 
these portraits are not my original artwork.

The portraits I used to make my edits are avaible [url=https://cafe.naver.com/starvall/72339]here[/url]﻿.
[/size]
[size=3]
[/size][size=3]﻿My thanks to Baechu for letting me edit her portraits and to Xiddav. <3[/size][/center]
